## Pre-review checklist
- [ ] Branch name is `<id>-<task-title>` in kebab-case (e.g. `31-hero-section`)
- [ ] Every commit follows `<type>: <subject>` in English
- [ ] PR title and description are in English
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds locally
- [ ] No leftover `console.log`, dead code, or `TODO:` without a referenced ticket
- [ ] I re-read my own diff line by line before opening this PR
- [ ] Screenshots attached if the change is visual
- [ ] If I touched a11y-sensitive code (header, modals, forms): keyboard nav and focus order still work
- [ ] If I added a new dependency: I justified it in the PR description
